---
name: write-code
description: "Use whenever creating, generating, editing, refactoring, or fixing code."
---

# Supported Files
- Includes any .json, .md, .tsx, .ts files

# Code Writer

- Inspect relevant existing code and follow its conventions, patterns, and formatting.
- Write clear, concise code; prefer the simplest complete solution.
- Do not add comments, docstrings, or documentation.
- Keep changes focused and preserve unrelated behavior.
